record.original_question: Find a bound for |μ(σ, τ)| in the permutation pattern poset that depends only on the number of occurrences of σ in τ, without requiring additional structure such as separability.

evidence.quote: Another question raised in [19] is whether it is possible to find a bound on |µ(σ, τ)| that depends only on the number of occurrences of σ in τ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ denote the set of all finite permutations. For permutations $\sigma=\sigma_1\sigma_2\cdots\sigma_k$ and $\tau=\tau_1\tau_2\cdots\tau_n$ with $k\le n$, say that $\sigma$ occurs as a pattern in $\tau$ if there exist indices $1\le i_1<i_2<\cdots<i_k\le n$ such that, for all $a,b\in\{1,\dots,k\}$, $\tau_{i_a}<\tau_{i_b}$ if and only if $\sigma_a<\sigma_b$. Each such index tuple is called an occurrence of $\sigma$ in $\tau$; let $\mathrm{occ}(\sigma,\tau)$ denote the total number of occurrences. The relation "$\sigma$ occurs in $\tau$" defines a partial order on $S$, the permutation pattern poset $(S,\le)$. Let $\mu$ denote the Möbius function of this poset, defined recursively by $\mu(\sigma,\sigma)=1$ and, for $\sigma<\tau$, $\mu(\sigma,\tau)=-\sum_{\sigma\le\pi<\tau}\mu(\sigma,\pi)$.

Problem: Find a function $f:\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}\to\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$ such that, for every pair $\sigma\le\tau$ in $S$,
$$|\mu(\sigma,\tau)|\le f(\mathrm{occ}(\sigma,\tau)),$$
without imposing any additional structural restriction (such as separability) on $\sigma$ or $\tau$.
artifact.category_tag: Möbius function of permutation pattern poset
artifact.status_search_result: Bounds on |μ(σ,τ)| in terms of the number of occurrences of σ in τ are known for restricted classes (e.g., separable permutations, and conjecturally for 132-avoiding permutations), but no such bound depending only on the occurrence count, valid for all permutations without structural restrictions, appears to have been established. Research on the Möbius function of the permutation pattern poset remains active, with recent work giving formulas in terms of "normal occurrences" but not a general bound of the requested form.

status_evidence.title: The Möbius Function of the Permutation Pattern Poset
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces the question and proves bounds for separable permutations.
status_evidence.claim: A bound by the number of occurrences is established for separable permutations, leaving the general case open.

status_evidence.title: A formula for the Möbius function of the permutation poset based on a topological decomposition
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a two-term formula involving normal occurrences but not a general occurrence-only bound.
status_evidence.claim: Recent formulas give partial information but do not yield a bound depending only on the occurrence count for general permutations.
